# Documentation templates

Use these templates to reduce drift from repository documentation conventions.

## Available templates

- [`plan-template.md`](./plan-template.md) — for new non-trivial implementation plans in `docs/plans/`
- [`decision-record-template.md`](./decision-record-template.md) — for new ADR-style records in `docs/decisions/`
- [`final-report-template.md`](./final-report-template.md) — for final task reports that must cite evidence and consulted decision records
- [`../tickets/template.md`](../tickets/template.md) — for new Markdown tickets in `docs/tickets/`

## When to use them

- creating a new plan
- adding a new decision record
- writing a structured final report after finishing work
- creating a new Markdown ticket

## Maintenance

Update these templates when repository documentation rules change.
